sections.text:
Ability Power 210. Damages all enemies with magic wind damage.
Added effect: Fire, water, wind, light, and dark Elemental Attack increased for all allies by 4 for 60 seconds, and casts “Tohsaka’s Magic” (casts elevate and all stats boosted by 30%) on yourself for 60 seconds.
Level bonus: Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
